system.description: The body contains a great deal of water, in the form of sweat, tears... but mostly blood. Immaculates of Water learn the secret tides of blood, and they can strike a target in such a way that it disrupts and diverts a victim's blood. By channeling it into the target's airways and lungs, an Immaculate can actually drown his foe in her own blood. After a successful Martial Arts attack, which does not damage the target, the Immaculate's player (Strength + Martial Arts) opposed by the target's (Stamina + Resistance). If the Immaculate wins, his target suffers internal bleeding and loses one dot of Stamina for a number of actions equal to the Immaculate's extra successes. Subsequent uses of the Charm are cumulative, and a target reduced to 0 Stamina is dead.
